title: Xtant Medical Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Xtant Medical Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026 announcing a Distribution Agreement with Dilon Technologies granting exclusive U.S. rights to market and distribute the HEMOBLAST® Bellows surgical hemostatic agent. Xtant paid a $5.0 million exclusivity fee and hired approximately 20 Dilon sales personnel. The product is manufactured in France and sold under FDA approval.
key_points: Xtant Medical entered a Distribution Agreement with Dilon Technologies on April 10, 2026
Xtant obtained exclusive rights to import, market, distribute, and sell HEMOBLAST® Bellows in the United States
HEMOBLAST® Bellows is an FDA-approved powder-based, topical surgical hemostatic agent
Dilon will continue manufacturing the product from France and supply to Xtant at a specified transfer price
Xtant paid a $5.0 million exclusivity fee to Dilon, subject to repayment under certain circumstances
Xtant hired approximately 20 Dilon sales personnel to support sales in the United States
The Distribution Agreement contains no minimum purchase requirements for Xtant
